cards.card_text: Then Jesus lists what comes out: evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance and foolishness.
cards.verse_text: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
cards.snippet: …men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.

cards.card_text: That means not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery.
cards.verse_text: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.
cards.snippet: …the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.

cards.card_text: Paul names what they haven't repented of: impurity, sexual immorality and debauchery.
cards.verse_text: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.
cards.snippet: …and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.

cards.card_text: Peter tells them they've spent enough time already carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.
cards.verse_text: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
cards.snippet: …the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
